biography_english:
A Loslorien commander hailing from Bomouth on the borderlands of Lodis.
  He is a giant of a man, and the most bloodthirsty of the seven Loslorien commanders. He was put on trial for beating a superior to death, but was saved from execution by Lanselot Tartaros.
  He led the Bakram forces invading Rhime, and battled the Holy Knight Lanselot there. He was also among the Dark Knights who attacked Golyat a year ago.
biography_spanish:
Comandante de Loslorien, de Bomouth, en la frontera de Lodis.
  De gran estatura, es el mas sanguinario de los siete comandantes de Loslorien. Fue juzgado por matar a golpes a un superior, pero Lanselot Tartaros lo salvo de la ejecucion.
  Lidero a las tropas bakramianas en la invasion de Rhime y lucho alli contra el paladin Lanselot. Tambien estuvo entre los Caballeros Oscuros que atacaron Golyat hace un ano.

biography_english:
A Loslorien commander hailing from Bomouth, a town in the Lodis marches. He is a giant of a man, and the most bloodthirsty of the seven Loslorien commanders. He was put on trial for beating a superior to death, but was saved from execution by Lanselot Tartaros.
  He attempted to waylay the Resistance forces attacking Barnicia Castle, but was routed by them.
biography_spanish:
Comandante de Loslorien, de Bomouth, en la frontera de Lodis. De gran estatura, es el mas sanguinario de los siete comandantes de Loslorien. Fue juzgado por matar a golpes a un superior, pero Lanselot Tartaros lo salvo de la ejecucion.
  Intento emboscar a las fuerzas de la Resistencia que atacaban el castillo de Barnicia, pero fue derrotado por estas.

biography_english:
A Loslorien commander hailing from Bomouth, a town in the Lodis marches. He is a giant of a man, and the most bloodthirsty of the seven Loslorien commanders. He was put on trial for beating a superior to death, but was saved from execution by Lanselot Tartaros.
  He rebelled with Sirs Martym and Andoras to obtain the legacy of King Dorgalua. They took possession of Brynhildr and fled to the Hanging Gardens.
biography_spanish:

  Se rebelo con sir Martym y sir Andoras para obtener el legado del rey Dorgalua. Tras hacerse con Brunilda, huyeron a los Jardines Colgantes.

biography_english:
A Loslorien commander hailing from Bomouth, a town in the Lodis marches. He was a giant of a man, and the most bloodthirsty of the seven Loslorien commanders. He was put on trial for beating a superior to death, but was saved from execution by Lanselot Tartaros.
  He rebelled with Sirs Martym and Andoras to obtain the legacy of King Dorgalua. They used Brynhildr to open the Chaos Gate, but were slain in a battle with {hero}.
biography_spanish:

  Se rebelo con sir Martym y sir Andoras para obtener el legado de Dorgalua. Usaron a Brunilda para abrir el Portal del Caos, mas cayeron en lucha con {hero}.

biography_english:
A Loslorien commander from Galius, seat of the Holy Lodissian Empire, and twin brother to Dame Ozma.
  He is an expert swordsman, receiving top honors from the Xanam Officer's Academy. After serving as commander of three regiments of the Ganan Division for a number of years, he was assigned to the Dark Knights. His sadistic nature is evident in his actions on the field of battle and in his questioning of prisoners.
  Ordered by Lanselot Tartaros to finish off remaining partisan forces, he headed to Boed Fortress with Dame Ozma.
biography_spanish:
Comandante de Loslorien, de Galius, sede de Lodis, y hermano gemelo de lady Ozma.
  Es un esgrimista experto que se graduo con honores en la Academia de Oficiales de Xanam. Tras comandar tres regimientos de la Division Ganan durante varios anos, fue asignado a los Caballeros Oscuros. Su caracter sadico queda patente en el campo de batalla y al interrogar prisioneros.
  Bajo ordenes de Lanselot Tartaros de acabar con los partisanos restantes, partio hacia la fortaleza de Boed con Dama Ozma.

biography_english:
A Loslorien commander from Galius, seat of the Holy Lodissian Empire, and twin brother to Dame Ozma.
  He was an expert swordsman, receiving top honors from the Xanam Officer's Academy. He was assigned to the Dark Knights at the recommendation of the Galius Guild of Magi. His sadistic nature was evident in his actions on the field of battle and in his questioning of prisoners.
  He died battling Resistance forces after attacking a group of partisans at Boed Fortress.
biography_spanish:
Comandante de Loslorien, de Galius, sede de Lodis, y hermano gemelo de lady Ozma.

  Murio luchando contra la Resistencia tras atacar a unos partisanos en la fortaleza de Boed.

biography_english:
The former Walister lord of Almorica Castle.
  After the onset of war, he led the beleaguered Walister people in their resistance of the Galgastani. They fought resolutely for many months before facing defeat, unable to match the might of the opposing armies.
  The Duke is currently held prisoner in Almorica Castle, and rumor has it his execution draws near.
biography_spanish:
Anterior lider walisteriano del castillo de Almorica.
  Tras estallar la guerra, lidero la resistencia del asediado pueblo walisteriano contra los galgastanies. Lucharon con firmeza durante meses antes de caer derrotados, incapaces de igualar el poderio enemigo.
  El duque esta preso en el castillo de Almorica, y se rumorea que su ejecucion se aproxima.

biography_english:
The leader of the Walister Resistance.
  After the onset of war, he led the beleaguered Walister people in their resistance of the Galgastani. They fought resolutely for many months before facing defeat, unable to match the might of the opposing armies. The Duke was held prisoner in his own castle, but was later freed by a group of partisans. He then took the helm of the Resistance once more.
biography_spanish:
Lider de la Resistencia walisteriana.
  Tras estallar la guerra, lidero la resistencia del asediado pueblo walisteriano contra los galgastanies. Lucharon con firmeza durante meses antes de caer derrotados, incapaces de igualar el poderio enemigo. El duque estuvo preso en su propio castillo, pero fue liberado por un grupo de partisanos. Retomo entonces el mando de la Resistencia.

biography_english:
The former leader of the Walister Resistance.
  After the onset of war, he led the beleaguered Walister people in their resistance of the Galgastani. The Duke was held prisoner in his own castle, but was later freed by a group of partisans. He then took the helm of the Resistance once more.
  However, the massacre at Balmamusa and the failure of the Psonji offensive caused his people to lose faith in him. He was murdered through the betrayal of Sir Leonar, who feared the Resistance to be on the verge of collapse.
biography_spanish:
Anterior lider de la Resistencia walisteriana.
  Tras estallar la guerra, lidero la resistencia del asediado pueblo walisteriano contra los galgastanies. El duque estuvo preso en su propio castillo, pero fue liberado por un grupo de partisanos. Retomo entonces el mando de la Resistencia.
  Sin embargo, la masacre de Balmamusa y el fracaso de la ofensiva de Psonji le hicieron perder la fe de su pueblo. Fue asesinado por la traicion de sir Leonar, quien temia que la Resistencia estuviera al borde del colapso.

biography_english:
The former leader of the Walister Resistance.
  After the onset of war, he led the beleaguered Walister people in their resistance of the Galgastani. The Duke was held prisoner in his own castle, but was later freed by a group of partisans. He then took the helm of the Resistance once more.
  After the massacre at Balmamusa, he overthrew Hierophant Balbatos and took control of Coritanae. However, he was assassinated during the attempt to recapture Rhime from the Bakram.
biography_spanish:
Anterior lider de la Resistencia walisteriana.
  Tras estallar la guerra, lidero la resistencia del asediado pueblo walister contra los galgastanies. Estuvo preso en su propio castillo, pero fue liberado por un grupo de partisanos y retomo el mando.
  Tras la masacre de Balmamusa, derroco al jerarca Balbatos y tomo el control de Coritanae. Sin embargo, fue asesinado durante el intento de reconquistar Rhime de manos de los bakramenses.

  After the massacre at Balmamusa, he overthrew Hierophant Balbatos and took control of Coritanae. However, he was assassinated by one of his own men during the attempt to recapture Rhime from the Bakram.
biography_spanish:

  Tras la masacre de Balmamusa, derroco al jerarca Balbatos y tomo Coritanae. Sin embargo, fue asesinado por un subordinado al intentar reconquistar Rhime de manos de los bakramenses.

biography_english: A Bakram who once ruled the Kingdom of Valeria. He united the scattered dominions of Valeria through his great vision and public favor. Upon becoming king he sought to end hostilities between the various factions. He left no successor, and war soon broke out in Valeria following his death.
biography_spanish: Un bakramense que goberno el Reino de Valeria. Unio los dominios dispersos de Valeria con su gran vision y el favor popular. Al ser rey, busco acabar con las hostilidades entre las distintas facciones. No dejo sucesor y tras su muerte pronto estallo la guerra en Valeria.

biography_english:
A Bakram who once ruled the Kingdom of Valeria. He united the scattered dominions of Valeria through his great vision and public favor. Upon becoming king he sought to end hostilities between the various factions.
  He became distraught after losing his wife and son in rapid succession, and sought the power to bring them back by triggering a Chaos Gate deep within the Hanging Gardens. He was instead imprisoned within it by an evil force.
  His corrupted form emerged once more when the gate was opened by the Dark Knight Martym, but he was defeated by {hero}.
biography_spanish:
Un bakramense que goberno el Reino de Valeria. Unio los dominios dispersos de Valeria con su gran vision y el favor popular. Al ser rey, busco acabar con las hostilidades entre las distintas facciones.
  Quedo desolado tras perder a su esposa e hijo seguidos, y busco el poder para devolverles la vida activando la Puerta del Caos en lo profundo de los Jardines Colgantes. Sin embargo, una fuerza maligna lo encerro en ella.
  Su forma corrupta reaparecio cuando el caballero oscuro Martym abrio la puerta, pero fue derrotado por {hero}.

biography_english:
A Bakram who serves as regent to the Bakram-Valerian Kingdom. Following the death of King Dorgalua, he aspired to rule Valeria himself.
  Though once a mere abuna in the Order of Philaha, he used his growing power in the church to intervene in the power struggle caused by the lack of a successor. He consolidated his political power by courting the favor of the noble and wealthy. Backed by the military might of Lodis to the north, he established the Bakram-Valerian Kingdom and installed himself as regent. The kingdom is headed by the heir of House Eltynaha due to their blood ties with Queen Vernotta, but it is Brantyn who rules.
biography_spanish:
Un bakramense que ejerce como regente del Reino de Bakram-Valeria. Tras la muerte del rey Dorgalua, ambiciono gobernar Valeria.
  Aunque en su dia fue un mero abuna de la Orden de Philaha, aprovecho su creciente poder eclesiastico para intervenir en la lucha por el poder causada por la falta de sucesor. Consolido su poder politico ganandose el favor de nobles y ricos. Con el respaldo militar de Lodis desde el norte, fundo el Reino de Bakram-Valeria y se nombro regente. El reino esta liderado por la heredera de la Casa Eltynaha debido a sus lazos de sangre con la reina Vernotta, pero es Brantyn quien gobierna.

biography_english:
A Bakram who once served as regent to the Bakram-Valerian Kingdom. He was brother to Abuna Prancet, and the uncle of {hero}.
  Though once a mere abuna of the Order of Philaha, after the king's death he shared his knowledge of Catiua with the queen to curry favor, and attained the rank of exarch. He then exploited his position to intervene in the power struggle caused by the lack of a successor. He consolidated his political power through the support of the noble and wealthy classes. Backed by the military might of Lodis to the north, he established the Bakram-Valerian Kingdom and installed himself as regent. The kingdom was headed by the heir of House Eltynaha due to their blood ties with Queen Vernotta, but Brantyn ruled from the shadows.
  Brantyn was ordered to make peace with the Resistance when Princess Versalia's existence came to light, but he would not relent. He died fighting Resistance forces at Heim Castle.
biography_spanish:
Un bakramense que ejercio de regente del Reino de Bakram-Valeria. Era hermano del abuna Prancet y tio de {hero}.
  Aunque en su dia fue un mero abuna de la Orden de Philaha, tras la muerte del rey compartio su saber sobre Catiua con la reina para ganarse su favor y alcanzo el rango de exarca. Aprovecho su posicion para intervenir en la lucha por el poder causada por la falta de sucesor. Consolido su poder politico con el apoyo de la nobleza y los mas ricos. Con el respaldo militar de Lodis al norte, fundo el Reino de Bakram-Valeria y se nombro regente. El reino estaba liderado por la heredera de la Casa Eltynaha por sus lazos de sangre con la reina Vernotta, pero Brantyn gobernaba en la sombra.
  Se le ordeno hacer la paz con la Resistencia al revelarse la existencia de la princesa Versalia, pero no cedio. Murio luchando contra la Resistencia en el castillo de Heim.

biography_english: A Galgastani who serves the Kingdom of Galgastan. He was consul to Almorica while it was under Galgastani control; however, it appears he left his duties to a knight in his service, and was rarely seen in public. He was traveling to Krysaro when Almorica Castle fell.
biography_spanish: Un galgastani al servicio del Reino de Galgastan. Fue consul de Almorica mientras estuvo bajo control galgastani; pero dejo sus deberes a un caballero a su servicio y rara vez se le vio en publico. Viajaba a Krysaro cuando cayo el Castillo de Almorica.
